Every function of the package, by topic

Source: R/functions.R
vp_functions.Rd

A table of the functions of variplex: the topic, the name, the parameters as one would type them (a parameter with a default shows it) and the question each function answers. The topics follow the vignettes.

Usage

vp_functions(topic = NULL)

Arguments

topic

A part of the name of a topic, such as "conflicts" or "evol"; NULL lists every function.

Value

A tibble with the columns topic (a factor, in the order of the vignettes), name, parameters and answers.

See also

Other reading: vp_classify(), vp_example(), vp_expand(), vp_features(), vp_generate(), vp_history(), vp_igraph(), vp_links(), vp_minimal(), vp_read(), vp_read_history(), vp_read_uvl_tree(), vp_representativeness(), vp_subset()
